**Renamed and expanded NBA game structure arbitrage skill to cover 48h market window.**

- Renamed skill from "polymarket-24h-nba-game-structure-trader" to "polymarket-48h-nba-game-structure-trader."
- Trades structural inconsistencies across correlated NBA moneyline, spread, O/U, and 1H markets on Polymarket.
- Detects and trades on cross-market mispricings including monotonicity violations, 1H vs full-game divergences, and spread-moneyline directional conflicts.
- Full strategy, logic, safety details, and configuration now documented in SKILL.md.
- Includes risk controls and paper/live trade modes; nothing runs automatically until enabled.
